# UnderwriteOS

> API-first underwriting infrastructure for lenders and fintechs.

UnderwriteOS normalizes credit bureau, open banking and financial document data into a canonical model, generates structured risk signals with full evidence lineage, evaluates your versioned policy, and returns an explainable underwriting decision (APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE) over a versioned REST API.

## What it does

- **Normalize** — Turn credit, bank and document data into a consistent financial and credit profile.
- **Analyze** — Generate structured risk signals across credit, cashflow and affordability.
- **Decide** — Apply your policy and return an explainable decision with evidence.

## Two ways to use it

- **No code** — A guided wizard to underwrite a borrower without integration.
- **API integration** — A versioned REST API with environment-scoped keys, webhooks, providers and usage billing.

## Key capabilities

- Evidence graph: every decision is traceable to the source field it came from.
- AI assists, your policy decides — the lender's versioned policy is authoritative.
- Cross-border credit profile portability with attested provenance.
- Model-monitoring feedback loop: predicted vs actual default calibration.
- Sandbox / production isolation, organization-scoped access, audit logs, idempotency.

## API (v1)

- POST /v1/applications — create an application
- POST /v1/applications/{id}/credit-report — ingest credit bureau data
- POST /v1/applications/{id}/bank-statement — ingest bank data
- POST /v1/applications/{id}/analyze — generate risk signals
- POST /v1/applications/{id}/underwrite — return a decision
- GET /v1/applications/{id}/evidence-graph — decision lineage
